research.headline: Birth flower and birthstone charms fit the Christmas gift window: 87 days out, and 62 recent orders show buyers already choose them.

whyNow.summary: Christmas is 87 days away, which leaves room for the six weeks a product campaign needs to learn and still finish before the last gift orders. Your buyers chose these listings 62 times in the last 90 days, and free listings are already converting.

timing.label: Christmas
timing.note: Gift shoppers search for personalised jewellery from early November; learning has to finish before then.

timing.label: Canadian Thanksgiving
timing.note: Only 13 days out, not enough time for a new campaign to learn before the weekend.

timing.label: Valentine's Day
timing.note: A second window for the same gift buyers; the campaign can carry on into it.

evidence: 62 orders matched these three listings in the last 90 days, 18 of them in the last 30.
The best complete month so far was August, with 24 orders.
Free Merchant Center listings converted 31 times in 30 days.
Paid product ads have reported 4 conversions from USD 96.20 of spend.
All three listings are in stock and approved in Merchant Center for the US feed.
whyNow.marketRead: Searches for birth flower and birthstone gifts usually start climbing in early November and peak in the two weeks before Christmas. Personalised pieces sell out of shipping slots earlier than ready-made ones.
whyNow.caution: Birth flower necklaces are widely advertised, so click costs may be high before the season peaks.
